# Scatterplot Layer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A circle per row.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "scatter", "name": "scatter", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:radiusScale`, or read elsewhere as `ch('scatter/radiusScale')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Remarks

Scatterplot Layer draws one circle per row of its input. Position, Color and Radius are per-row expressions over the rows' columns, or the name of a column an [Attribute Create](./attribute.md) made. Position defaults to `P`, so until a column named `P` exists or Position names another, the layer has nothing to place.

A few defaults differ from deck.gl's own ScatterplotLayer, which matters when you follow the deck.gl docs:

| Parameter | Here | deck.gl |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `radiusUnits` | `"pixels"` | `"meters"` |
| `radiusScale` | `4` | `1` |

Circles therefore keep their size on screen as you zoom. To size them on the ground, set Radius units to meters.

An empty Color draws every circle in Fill color. A Color expression gives `[r, g, b]` from 0 to 255, or uses `ramp(t)` for a value from 0 to 1 on the layer's Color ramp. Radius scale, Fill color and Opacity are deck props: dragging them redraws without reading any rows again.

## Examples

Circles at each row's longitude and latitude, sized on the ground:

```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "scatter", "name": "points", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": { "position": "[lng, lat]", "radius": "sqrt(mag) * 500", "radiusScale": 1, "radiusUnits": "meters" } }
```
